operationGuide.aCompactRealReplayNoRawDe: A compact real replay; no raw Demo import or parsing required.
operationGuide.learnTheViewsReplayUtilit: Learn the views, replay, utility notes and collaboration in the actual workspace. Skip any time, or restart from ? in the upper-right of the main view.
operationGuide.openAParsedDemoFromTheLoc: Open a parsed Demo from the local list to try this step, or continue reading the guide.
steps.chooseABrushColorAndWidthThenDragO: Choose a brush color and width, then drag on the ground to draw. Ctrl + left drag erases; Ctrl + Z/Y undo and redo. Open a room when you want others to join; collaboration uses a server, while your archives remain local.
steps.chooseADemFileWaitForParsingThenOp: Choose a .dem file, wait for parsing, then open it from the local Demo list. This guide includes a compact falcons-vs-vitality-m3-dust2 replay, starting at round 22, so you can practice without importing or parsing a file. You can also use your own match.
steps.choosePlayersAndParsedDemosInTheRi: Choose players and parsed Demos in the right sidebar. The built-in example starts with TeSeS selected; you can change the selection. Movement, heat maps and combat views offer other ways to review a match; this tour focuses on utility events.
steps.createALocalArchiveFromTheRightSid: Create a local archive from the right sidebar, then edit its tactical frames. This browser edition does not parse Demos, but saved utility and collaboration remain available.
steps.dragTheTimelineToInspectAMomentInc: Drag the timeline to inspect a moment, including freeze time before the round. Event markers jump to key moments. Space toggles playback; arrow keys step through the replay.
steps.dragTheTimelineToSeekAndTapPlayPau: Drag the timeline to seek and tap Play/Pause. Tap event markers to jump to key moments; drag before the round start to inspect freeze time.
steps.dragWithOneFingerToRotateUseTwoFin: Drag with one finger to rotate; use two fingers to pan and pinch to zoom. In 2D, twist two fingers to rotate. An external mouse and keyboard still use the desktop controls.
steps.enableTheDrawingSwitchInTheMapCont: Enable the drawing switch in the map controls, choose a brush and draw on the ground. Turn it off to resume camera gestures. Use the visible undo/redo buttons. Open a room for live collaboration.
steps.in3dEnableAMapModelAndAdjustIts: In 3D, enable a map model and adjust its opacity and view range to inspect positions inside buildings. Models load when enabled; no imported model is required to use the NAV ground.
steps.insertAFrameForTheNextStageOrDupli: Insert a frame for the next stage, or duplicate one to keep its layout before making changes. Use the frame strip to switch stages. Save your archive when ready.
steps.openANoteAndCopyItsGetposPositionC: Open a note and copy its getpos position command to reproduce its starting position and aim in CS2. You can also add a note by pasting the game console output from getpos. Position alone does not reproduce a moving throw: use the recorded movement and key display too.
steps.openTheArchiveContainingYourTwoSav: Open the archive containing your two saved frames. Restore it to edit those player layouts on the board. The frame strip switches between the moments; no live room is required.
steps.openTheRoundSelectorAndChooseARoun: Open the round selector and choose a round. The economy indicators help identify different buys. Selecting a round starts at the end of freeze time.
steps.openViewSettingsInTheBottomBarForM: Open View settings in the bottom bar for model opacity and view range. If no model is available, you can continue using the NAV ground.
steps.pressCtrlANumberToSaveTheCurrentCa: Press Ctrl + a number to save the current camera position, and that number to restore it. Click a saved position in the map controls to restore it.
steps.restoreTheSavedPlayerLayoutsThenDr: Restore the saved player layouts, then drag players to move. The Move / Aim / Pitch buttons change the drag action. Add saved utility from the left panel; a connected keyboard also supports E and Q.
steps.returnToMatchReplayPauseAtAUsefulM: Return to Match Replay, pause at a useful moment and Save current frame into a new archive. Seek to another moment and save again into that same archive. Saving the frame preserves the current player layout, not the original Demo file. These saves create your own editable tactical frames.
steps.selectUtilityEventsThenFilterByUti: Select Utility events, then filter by utility type and team. Inspect throw origins, trajectories and effects. Hover to preview with the spotlight; touch users can select a throw.
steps.switchBetween3dAndATopDown2dView: Switch between 3D and a top-down 2D view. In 2D you can zoom, rotate and see multiple floors side by side. The map preview helps you find your bearings.
steps.tapASavedCameraPositionToRestoreIt: Tap a saved camera position to restore it. Tap Save camera, then select a slot to save the current view.
steps.theThrowYouSavedIsNowAvailableHere: The throw you saved is now available here. Use folders and landing-location sorting to organize notes. Select a throw to inspect its details; replayable notes support full and first-person playback.
steps.thisStepSelectsAllAvailablePlayers: This step selects all available players on the map so more recommendations can be found. The left sidebar groups similar throws by frequency. The count is the actual number of throws; the score is not a success rate. Focus a group to compare it, then add its representative throw. This saves a real recorded throw to Utility Notes.
steps.useFloorSelectionOnMultiLevelMapsT: Use floor selection on multi-level maps to inspect upper or lower ground. Single-level maps need no split. In 2D, floors are shown together side by side.
steps.useWasdToMoveMiddleMouseToRotateSh: Use WASD to move, middle mouse to rotate, Shift + middle mouse or right mouse to pan, and the wheel to zoom. Hover over the ? in the upper-right corner whenever you forget a control.
steps.withAnArchiveOpenEPlacesAPlayerAt: With an archive open, E places a player at the cursor and Q opens the utility wheel. Drag players to move; Ctrl + left drag adjusts aim, Shift + left drag adjusts pitch, and double-click toggles crouch. The left panel lists players and lets you add saved utility.
steps.youCanReviewTheseStepsAtAnyTimeBy: You can review these steps at any time by clicking ? in the upper-right corner. Hover there for a quick controls reference. Your saved notes and tactical frames remain available after the guide closes.
workspaceHelp.oneFingerRotatesTwoFingers: One finger rotates; two fingers pan or pinch to zoom. With drawing enabled, one finger draws. A connected keyboard and mouse support the shortcuts below.
